component.name: Hangar App Manager
component.summary: One inventory for all the software on your computer

description.p: Hangar detects applications installed with APT, Snap and Flatpak, AppImages, vendor packages and manually installed software, and shows them in one place.

ul.li: Updates from APT, Snap and Flatpak with real-time progress
Safe, previewed uninstallation; user files go to the Trash
Discovery engine for software installed without a package manager
Activity history and review decisions stored locally
